user_request_ru: Увеличить в 100 раз учитываемые операции и прогнать R5F заново.

original.original_outcome: Strong exact forward 200 answers, reverse-only 120, reverse+replay 160; no strong-baseline advantage.

interventions.first: BUDGET_ONLY: original unchanged 9-edge DAG at 50,000 hard counted edge/candidate operations, control whether budget alone changes answers.
interventions.second: EXPANDED_CAUSAL_GRAPH: 100 disjoint copies of original 5 A-to-B and 4 B-to-C edges, 900 total authoritative graph edges, 50000 allowed counted operations. All 100 alternative A/B subgraphs can reach the fixed terminal C0; copies are not independent sensor observations.
interventions.workload_confound: Added alternatives make causal ambiguity at least as difficult, while original witness roots and authored scenario types remain unchanged. This is a structural stress test not new external independent tasks.
interventions.fair_inputs: All algorithms receive exact same expanded graph, terminal, reverse proposals, source-root evidence, authoritatively complete forward DAG and 50k max counted operations.
interventions.no_fake_repetitions: Operation count increments only inside real original graph traversals and actual replays. No artificial multiplier or repeated same-case timer padding.
interventions.check_budget: If a solver exceeds 50k counted operations it must ABSTAIN; all arms report budget-exceeded cases.
interventions.source_provenance: Synthetic roots not authenticated physical instruments.

split.no_new_gold: Gold is uniquely identifiable path under synthetic forward authoritative graph plus corroborated witness constraints; not observed physical history or external blind.
split.control: Original R5F replay on exact same 600 cases at 500 budget, budget-only replay at 50k, real expanded graph replay at 50k; measured in same CI run.
split.test_leakage: No scenario labels or oracle paths in visible graph; no updating algorithm from test errors.

arms.B_REVERSE_ONLY_UNVERIFIED: Backward proposed predecessors without authoritative forward replay
arms.C_REVERSE_PLUS_FORWARD_REPLAY: Backward C→B→A plus exact frozen A→B→C forward verification
arms.D_STRONG_EXHAUSTIVE_PROVENANCE: Exact forward search with same corroborated witness constraints (strong control)

primary: Valid answers, selective accuracy among answered, abstention count
Unsupported positive assertions when gold ambiguous
Mean actually counted graph operations/case and scaling ratio vs original
Cases over budget and fail-closed behavior
Coverage delta C vs strong D
secondary: Actual graph edge count vs original
Raw deterministic case input SHA-256 each arm/control
Uncalibrated same-worker median runtime; not standardized

acceptance.engineering_pass: Checks show exactly 900 authoritative graph edges vs 9, hard budget exactly 50k vs 500, 22 R5F-X100 checks pass, original R5F checks pass, strong reference correct under own graph oracle, no unsafe confident reconstruction, full Actions receipt.
acceptance.algorithmic_gain: If C beats strong exact D on valid coverage with no increase in incorrect claims and accounted cost (not expected by construction), label tentative synthetic-only.
acceptance.science: HOLD until independent externally authored, prospectively hidden, authenticated physical witness data and stronger realistic budget accounting.

next: If no advantage, test optimized path-consistency algorithms, indexed reachability and causal uncertainty on truly new graph distributions with independently authored gold; no automatic promotion.
